theFormatFinding.conclusion: It is the medium, not the design. Three separate visual systems have now been tested as flat stills and all three failed the same way.
theFormatFinding.action: Week 5 is video-led: 4 reels, 3 carousels, 2 stills. Single flat cards are on notice — if the carousels beat them, stills are retired.

notes: Worst published week the system has produced. Engagement average fell 7.09 to 6.19; followers fell 181 to 179 against a predicted 184-186.
Both published items went up as /p/ stills, not reels. Week 3's went up as /reel/ and scored 3-4x higher with a comparable design.
Media count 46 to 51, so five things were posted in total and only two were the system's.
Caption defects 19 to 16 — three more fixed by hand.
Saves and shares came back unmeasured again. Missing data, not zero.
The +4%/week growth model has now over-predicted three weeks running. Treat flat-to-+2 as the realistic base.

predictionForNextWeek.test: Do carousels beat single stills? This account has never run one. If a 5-slide educational carousel outperforms a flat card, the weekly mix moves permanently to reels plus carousels and single images are retired.
